title: Squared derivative of a monotone function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be monotone with respect to the coordinatewise orders. For every coordinate $i$ and every point $x$ in the sign cube, the square of the discrete derivative of the real-valued version of $f$ at $x$ equals that derivative.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a point of the sign cube
